ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentives to pregnant and lactating women for their first living child.
benefits: Cash incentive paid in installments linked to health checkups and childbirth registration.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women for first living child
Excludes women already receiving similar benefit under other schemes
application_steps: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility
Submit claim forms at each stage of eligibility
